what_this_is: Tools the tray offers (src/workspace/tray-screen.tsx offers every tool whose input takes `things`). tool:tell-trillions-makers hands what a person picked, their note, the screen, a picture and their browser to the account its invoke names (src/hand-to-an-account.mjs), as a row of that account's list and a notice. Another place to send a tray to is another row here. Its screen (group tell-us) is also a row of the Tell us list above Start, where a member reports a bug, sends feedback or shares an idea; what it is (kind) lands in the list's What it is field, and each note is handed to the operator account's AIs (invoke.hand_off).
